request:
Which classes defined in httpx/_exceptions.py are not subclassed by any other class anywhere in the repository (tests included)? Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: This query selects class symbols from httpx/_exceptions.py that do not appear as a base class in the class_bases view, meaning no other class in the repository inherits from them.
sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.file_id IN (SELECT f.file_id FROM code.files f WHERE f.module = '_exceptions') AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT cb.base_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT s2.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s2 WHERE s2.kind = 'class'))
